section_summary: This section records Japanese naval transport visits proposed for Los Angeles and Hawaiian ports between autumn 1936 and spring 1937, including the cancellation of the Sunosaki’s Los Angeles call and a later objection to the Sata’s proposed Los Angeles visit. It also contains correspondence about inviting a Japanese vessel to Port Arthur, Texas, and State Department memoranda on Japanese sailors’ participation in a Seattle parade.

subfiles.title: Proposed visit of Sunosaki
subfiles.about: Requests approval and customary courtesies for Sunosaki’s proposed Honolulu and Los Angeles calls.
subfiles.summary: Sunosaki would replenish supplies at Honolulu and take on crude oil at Los Angeles in October.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visit: California notification
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Sunosaki’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Notifies California of the scheduled Honolulu and Los Angeles calls.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visit: Navy notification
subfiles.about: Requests Navy courtesies for Sunosaki if there is no objection.
subfiles.summary: Gives the October schedule and purpose of each port call.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visit: War Department notification
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Sunosaki’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Relays the vessel’s October Honolulu and Los Angeles schedule.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visit: Treasury notification
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Sunosaki’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Relays the vessel’s October port schedule.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visit: Labor notification
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Sunosaki’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Relays the vessel’s October port schedule.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visit: Agriculture notification
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Sunosaki’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Relays the vessel’s October port schedule.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki visit: Interior notification
subfiles.about: Requests customary courtesies for Sunosaki’s proposed visits.
subfiles.summary: Relays the vessel’s October port schedule.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Sunosaki visit request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the proposed visits and consultation with authorities.
subfiles.summary: State has contacted federal departments and California; weather changes are understood to mean delayed arrivals.

subfiles.title: Port Arthur Chamber thanks State Department
subfiles.about: Thanks State for transmitting Port Arthur’s vessel invitation and the Texas governor’s endorsement.
subfiles.summary: The chamber appreciates State’s handling of its invitation.

subfiles.title: Review of Seattle Japanese sailors’ parade
subfiles.about: Reviews delays and responsibility surrounding Japanese sailors’ participation in Seattle’s July Fourth parade.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum disputes a naval commandant’s suggestion that State alone caused delay or granted permission. It traces consultation among State, War, Navy, and Seattle officials, explaining that organizers proceeded on their own responsibility after an invitation had already been issued. It recommends prompt field reports and immediate oral consultation among departments in future cases.

subfiles.title: Policy on foreign troops parading in the United States
subfiles.about: Clarifies diplomatic channels and general policy for inviting foreign troops to parade on American soil.
subfiles.summary: Invitations should pass between governments through the State Department. Armed foreign troops generally should not parade on American soil, with possible exceptions for Canadian and other American troops.

subfiles.title: Treasury approval of Sunosaki port courtesies
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs collectors to extend usual courtesies to Sunosaki.
subfiles.summary: Collectors at Honolulu and Los Angeles are instructed to assist.

subfiles.title: Labor response concerning Sunosaki
subfiles.about: Instructs immigration personnel to extend lawful courtesies to Sunosaki’s crew.
subfiles.summary: Los Angeles and Honolulu representatives will assist subject to immigration laws.

subfiles.title: Navy response concerning Sunosaki
subfiles.about: Reports no Navy objection to Sunosaki’s visits.
subfiles.summary: Local naval officials have been directed to extend usual courtesies.

subfiles.title: File charge slip
subfiles.about: Records charges and handling of file 894.3311.
subfiles.summary: Lists file charges, dates, and related papers.

subfiles.title: Cancellation of Sunosaki’s Los Angeles visit
subfiles.about: Announces cancellation of Sunosaki’s proposed Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Requests notification of the appropriate United States authorities.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki cancellation: California
subfiles.about: Notifies California that Sunosaki’s Los Angeles call was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Refers to State’s earlier notice of the October visits.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki cancellation: Agriculture
subfiles.about: Notifies Agriculture that Sunosaki’s Los Angeles call was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Cites the Japanese Ambassador’s October 3 note.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki cancellation: Labor
subfiles.about: Notifies Labor that Sunosaki’s Los Angeles call was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Cites the Japanese Ambassador’s October 3 note.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki cancellation: Navy
subfiles.about: Notifies Navy that Sunosaki’s Los Angeles call was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Cites the Japanese Ambassador’s October 3 note.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki cancellation: War Department
subfiles.about: Notifies War that Sunosaki’s Los Angeles call was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Cites the Japanese Ambassador’s October 3 note.

subfiles.title: Sunosaki cancellation: Treasury
subfiles.about: Notifies Treasury that Sunosaki’s Los Angeles call was canceled.
subfiles.summary: Cites the Japanese Ambassador’s October 3 note.

subfiles.title: Acknowledgment of Sunosaki cancellation
subfiles.about: Confirms that relevant authorities were advised of Sunosaki’s canceled Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Acknowledges the ambassador’s October 3 note.

subfiles.title: File note on ports of entry policy
subfiles.about: Points to a memorandum proposing a ports of entry rule for foreign public vessels.
subfiles.summary: Notes rising Japanese requests and a proposed restriction to listed ports of entry.

subfiles.title: War Department response to Sunosaki cancellation
subfiles.about: Confirms Honolulu courtesies and notification of the canceled Los Angeles call.
subfiles.summary: Commands in Hawaii and the Ninth Corps Area received instructions.

subfiles.title: Treasury revokes Los Angeles authorization
subfiles.about: Revokes customs authorization for Sunosaki’s canceled Los Angeles visit.
subfiles.summary: The Los Angeles collector is being notified.

subfiles.title: File note on Japanese training ship near Pacific islands
subfiles.about: Points to a report of a Japanese training ship visiting Baker, Howland, and Jarvis Islands.
subfiles.summary: References Richard B. Black’s island colonization report.

subfiles.title: Port Arthur invitation and Japanese reply
subfiles.about: Reports Japan’s response to Port Arthur’s invitation for a naval vessel visit.
subfiles.summary: Japan appreciates the invitation but has no warship cruise planned off the eastern United States; it will reconsider if plans change.

subfiles.title: Invitation to Japanese naval vessel to visit Port Arthur
subfiles.about: Conveys Port Arthur Chamber of Commerce’s invitation for a future Japanese naval visit.
subfiles.summary: The Texas governor endorsed the chamber’s invitation; Dickover clarifies that it is not an official United States invitation.

subfiles.title: Japanese response to Port Arthur invitation
subfiles.about: Responds to Port Arthur’s invitation for a Japanese naval vessel.
subfiles.summary: No eastern United States cruise is planned; Japan will consider the invitation if that changes.

subfiles.title: State reports Japan’s response to Port Arthur
subfiles.about: Forwards the embassy despatch and Japan’s response to the chamber.
subfiles.summary: Japan will consider the invitation if a future cruise is planned.

subfiles.title: Proposed visits of Tsurumi and Naruto
subfiles.about: Requests approval for Tsurumi and Naruto to call at Los Angeles and Hawaiian ports.
subfiles.summary: Both would take on oil at Los Angeles; Tsurumi would replenish at Honolulu and Naruto at Hilo.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi and Naruto: California notification
subfiles.about: Requests courtesies for Tsurumi and Naruto’s proposed December and January calls.
subfiles.summary: Provides both vessels’ Los Angeles and Hawaiian schedules.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi and Naruto: Navy notification
subfiles.about: Requests Navy courtesies for Tsurumi and Naruto if there is no objection.
subfiles.summary: Provides oil loading and replenishment schedules for both transports.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi and Naruto: Treasury notification
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Tsurumi and Naruto’s proposed calls.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Los Angeles, Honolulu, and Hilo schedules.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi and Naruto: War Department notification
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Tsurumi and Naruto’s proposed calls.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Los Angeles, Honolulu, and Hilo schedules.

subfiles.summary: Lists the Los Angeles, Honolulu, and Hilo schedules.

subfiles.title: Tsurumi and Naruto: Labor notification
subfiles.about: Requests usual courtesies for Tsurumi and Naruto’s proposed calls.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Los Angeles, Honolulu, and Hilo schedules.

subfiles.title: Interim acknowledgment of Tsurumi and Naruto request
subfiles.about: Acknowledges the requested visits while federal and California authorities consider them.
subfiles.summary: Promises a further communication once a decision is reached.

subfiles.title: Labor response on Tsurumi and Naruto
subfiles.about: Confirms instructions to immigration district directors concerning Tsurumi and Naruto.
subfiles.summary: Los Angeles and Honolulu district directors received instructions.

subfiles.title: Copy of Labor response on Tsurumi and Naruto
subfiles.about: Duplicates the notice of instructions to immigration district directors.
subfiles.summary: Confirms instructions for Los Angeles and Honolulu.

subfiles.title: War Department response on Tsurumi and Naruto
subfiles.about: Reports instructions for military commands to extend courtesies to both transports.
subfiles.summary: Hawaiian and Ninth Corps Area commanders were notified.

subfiles.title: Treasury response on Tsurumi and Naruto
subfiles.about: Authorizes customs collectors to extend courtesies to Tsurumi and Naruto.
subfiles.summary: Los Angeles and Honolulu collectors are being notified.

subfiles.title: Navy response on Tsurumi and Naruto
subfiles.about: Reports no Navy objection to the proposed transport visits.
subfiles.summary: Naval commanders have been notified to extend courtesies.

subfiles.title: Approval of Tsurumi and Naruto visits
subfiles.about: Approves Tsurumi and Naruto’s proposed calls and customary courtesies.
subfiles.summary: State and the interested federal departments agree to the scheduled Los Angeles and Hawaiian visits.

subfiles.title: Port Arthur Chamber thanks State Department
subfiles.about: Thanks State for its report and assistance with invitations to Japanese warships.
subfiles.summary: The chamber acknowledges State’s correspondence about its invitations.

subfiles.title: Proposed visit of Sata

subfiles.summary: Proposes February calls under Commander Kunizo Mori.

subfiles.title: Objection to Sata’s Los Angeles visit
subfiles.about: Says Sata’s Los Angeles visit is inconvenient for interested United States authorities.
subfiles.summary: A further communication will address the Honolulu call.

subfiles.summary: Provides February and March schedules and names each ship’s commander.
